title: 295 Salt Box Lane Vacation Rental
meta_description: 295 Salt Box Lane is a 4.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental- 4 Seater Electric Cart for Guest Use Throughout The Community - Parking for 2 Vehicles- Screened Porch- Full Size Washer & Dryer- Second Sitting Area- Smart TVs- Outdoor Furniture- Propane Gas Grill- Exterior Shower- Private Gate Entrance to Neighborhood- 3 Minute Drive to Beach and Pool- 3 Minute Drive to The Big Chill 30A- 12 Minute Drive to Nearby Seaside DETAILS:Beautiful home, 295 Salt Box Lane, is located in the charming, private beach neighborhood of WaterSound. This newly remodeled home offers a relaxing escape with beaches, pools, shopping, and sightseeing all within walking distance. The home comfortably sleeps ten, featuring three bedrooms and a bunkroom on the main floor, each with a private bath. A queen room, a room with two twin beds, and a bunkroom with twin bunks provide inviting spaces in cool coastal colors. The spacious kitchen boasts elegant cabinets, premium countertops, and stainless steel appliances, perfect for any cooking enthusiast. The main floor also has a large dining area, cozy living room with smart tv, half bath, laundry, and home office.Upstairs, a stunning master suite awaits with a designer bath, walk-in shower, soaking tub, and a smart TV for your entertainment. For some alone time, head to the crow’s nest with a queen sofa sleeper, ideal for reading or a nap. Outside, kids can play while you unwind on the porches with fresh outdoor furniture. A four-seater golf cart is available to explore the scenic paths to South Walton’s sugar-white sands. With its ideal location and family-friendly amenities, make WaterSound your next unforgettable 30-A getaway!
